description: This file contains PHP code for handling advanced report filtering in vtiger CRM, including functions to generate HTML for primary and secondary filter columns, manage related fields, and process request parameters for report filtering.

methods.name: getPrimaryColumns_AdvFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML options for primary module columns in advanced filter.

methods.name: getSecondaryColumns_AdvFilterHTML
methods.description: Generates HTML options for secondary module columns in advanced filter.

methods.name: getRelatedColumns
methods.description: Returns related fields options based on selected criteria.

methods.name: getRelatedFieldColumns
methods.description: Returns related field columns for advanced filter.
